list.name: source_file
list.label: Source File
list.query:
import "influxdata/influxdb/schema"
schema.tagValues(bucket: "pdms_historical", tag: "source_file", predicate: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus_metric_file", start: 2026-04-27T14:45:00Z, stop: 2026-04-27T16:00:00Z)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "pdms_historical")
  |> range(start: 2026-04-27T14:45:00Z, stop: 2026-04-27T16:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus_metric_file")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.source_file == "${source_file}")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")

from(bucket: "pdms_historical")
  |> range(start: 2026-04-27T14:45:00Z, stop: 2026-04-27T16:00:00Z)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus_metric_file")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.source_file == "metrics_success_rate.json")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")

from(bucket: "pdms_historical")

  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prometheus_metric_file")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.source_file == "metrics_http_mean_latency.json")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")

from(bucket: "pdms_historical")
